title: TUI & CLI Design — design and build professional terminal interfaces
description: Use this when designing or building clean, professional, minimal terminal UI (TUI) applications and command-line tools. Covers full-screen TUIs (file managers, dashboards, monitors, git/k8s tools, REPLs), interactive CLI prompts, and simple command-line utilities. Includes per-ecosystem deep-dives (Go/Bubble Tea, Rust/Ratatui, Python/Textual, TypeScript/Ink), visual and interaction pattern references, exemplar app analysis, and universal TUI design principles.
